unresolved: L18, the label in the left margin: only «et M)» is in the image; by the right column's «(O)» probably «(C et M)», as on p. 7.
observations: The page number «13» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L13 end chapter 14, begun on p. 12 (JP2 0044). L14: the heading of chapter 15, in bold, centred.

L18-L36: chapter 15 continues in two columns, as chapter 7: on the left the text of C and M (L18-L27), on the right that of O (L28-L36), transcribed one after the other. Beside the first line of each column the sigla stand in the margin: «(O)» in the right margin; in the left margin the label is cut off at the left edge of the image, «et M)» visible, as on p. 7 (JP2 0039, L20), probably «(C et M)».

L21 and L25: «⟨lacuna⟩», the editor's mark of a gap in the text, «lacuna» in italics between upright angle brackets. L20 «elmeil», the declination (al-mail); L30 and L32 «shemeli», northern, and L33 «genubi», southern, in italics.

L24: the i of «trîa» is printed with a circumflex in the place of its dot, a sort of another fount; see the critical note. L07: a dark speck at mid-height between «id» and «transeat»; not transcribed.

N14: «ipsius ....]», the four points of the omission set close (15-16 px apart), where the other lemmas of the page space them about 25 px apart; the omission stands for the gap that the text marks with «⟨lacuna⟩» (L21), which M fills. N04: «sui . . . tempore», three points. N15: the bracket after «meridionalis» is printed faint at its head.
The colons and semicolons of the text stand after the thin space of the edition (10-13 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: the i of «tria» is printed with a circumflex, î, a sort of another fount; the word is «tria», as «prima tria» (L19) and «reliqua tria» (L26)
